tree.heading: Contracting agency.—
tree.text: The term “contracting agency”, when used with respect to a prime contractor, means a department, agency, or establishment of the Federal Government that enters into a prime contract with a prime contractor.

tree.heading: Kickback.—
tree.text: The term “kickback” means any money, fee, commission, credit, gift, gratuity, thing of value, or compensation of any kind that is provided to a prime contractor, prime contractor employee, subcontractor, or subcontractor employee to improperly obtain or reward favorable treatment in connection with a prime contract or a subcontract relating to a prime contract.

tree.heading: Person.—
tree.text: The term “person” means a corporation, partnership, business association of any kind, trust, joint-stock company, or individual.

tree.heading: Prime contract.—
tree.text: The term “prime contract” means a contract or contractual action entered into by the Federal Government to obtain supplies, materials, equipment, or services of any kind.

tree.heading: Prime contractor.—
tree.text: The term “prime contractor” means a person that has entered into a prime contract with the Federal Government.

tree.heading: Prime contractor employee.—
tree.text: The term “prime contractor employee” means an officer, partner, employee, or agent of a prime contractor.

tree.heading: Subcontract.—
tree.text: The term “subcontract” means a contract or contractual action entered into by a prime contractor or subcontractor to obtain supplies, materials, equipment, or services of any kind under a prime contract.

children.text: means a person, other than the prime contractor, that offers to furnish or furnishes supplies, materials, equipment, or services of any kind under a prime contract or a subcontract entered into in connection with the prime contract; and
includes a person that offers to furnish or furnishes general supplies to the prime contractor or a higher tier subcontractor.

tree.heading: Subcontractor employee.—
tree.text: The term “subcontractor employee” means an officer, partner, employee, or agent of a subcontractor.

notes.heading: Senate Revision Amendment
notes.text: Senate amendment 4726 (111th Cong.) added par. (3) and redesignated former pars. (3) to (8) as (4) to (9), respectively. See 156 Cong. Rec. 18683 (2010).
